comparison.objective: Transfer an out-of-flat wall profile onto a shelf end with a pencil compass.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual shelf stabilization and continuous contact tracing with fixed tool geometry.
comparison.success_condition: The scribed line matches the measured wall profile at specified stations and the compass is placed clear afterward.
comparison.reason: Contact-following and profile transcription do not test mixture feeding, orientation-dependent passage, bridge release, or retained-workpiece preservation. No material rubric detail is missing.
